archetype: ORGANIC & SWISS HYBRID (Islamic Educational Authority & Warmth)

kiosk_mode_design.description: Full-screen standalone RFID & 10-Digit NISN attendance kiosk designed for school entrance hardware/PCs.
kiosk_mode_design.layout: Full viewport (100vh), high contrast dark maroon frame (#4A0616), clean white modal display card.
kiosk_mode_design.header: Displays live digital clock with seconds, Indonesian date (e.g. Selasa, 14 Juli 2026), and active attendance type badge (Kehadiran Utama / Sholat Dhuha / Ekstrakurikuler).

input_section.rfid: Keyboard emulation auto-focus listener with subtle animated wave pulse visualizer.
input_section.nisn_lookup: Large 10-digit touch numeric keypad with clear key spacing, backspace, and submit button.
input_section.attendance_selector: 3 prominent toggle cards for 'Kehadiran Harian', 'Sholat Dhuha', and 'Ekstrakurikuler'.

success.audio: Web Audio API synth high-pitch double beep success chime
success.display: Large green checkmark, Student photo, NISN, Name, Class, and exact timestamp (e.g. '06:45:12 - Tepat Waktu')

already_scanned.audio: Web Audio API dual amber warning tone
already_scanned.display: Yellow alert icon, 'Sudah Absen Hari Ini', Timestamp

not_found.audio: Web Audio API low error buzz
not_found.display: Red cross icon, 'NISN / Kartu Tidak Ditemukan! Silakan hubungi TU.'

sidebar.style: Accordion grouped sidebar per role with smooth expandable sections.

topbar.style: Sticky header with school logo (MI Miftahul Jannah), active academic year badge (2025/2026 Sem 2), active role indicator, quick Kiosk launcher button, and user profile drop-down.

key_modules_design.master_data_tables: Dense Tailwind data tables with search inputs, filter dropdowns (Class 1A-6B), pagination controls, Excel/PDF export buttons, status badges, and action menus.
key_modules_design.kurikulum_merdeka_grades: Formative & Summatative score entry grids with auto-calculated final grades, achievement descriptors (Capaian Kompetensi), and printable Leger Nilai.
key_modules_design.tahfidz_quran: Juz 30 & Surah memorization tracker with visual progress bars, status tags (Lancar / Mutqin / Ziyadah / Muraja'ah), and audio/teacher note logs.
key_modules_design.student_savings: Bank-style savings transaction ledger featuring quick deposit/withdrawal action dialogs, printable receipt generator, and summary stat cards.
key_modules_design.teacher_journals: Daily classroom journal form with lesson material input, student anecdotal note logger, and piket log.

media_assets.description: Elementary Islamic school students learning Quran

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, inputs, links, tabs, table cells, and status indicators MUST include explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are developing JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components for the SIM MI Miftahul Jannah Web App.
Always apply the custom Maroon & Gold color palette using Tailwind classes (e.g., bg-[#800020], text-[#800020], border-[#D4AF37]/30).
Ensure Kiosk mode is an isolated full-screen view accessible via a prominent header action button.
Use Lucide-React icons throughout all navigation menus, action buttons, and table rows for strong visual cues.
Implement Web Audio API synth sounds (Beep/Chime) for the Attendance Kiosk feedback so no external sound file dependencies are needed.
Include sample seed data for 20+ students across Classes 1A-6B, Kurikulum Merdeka subject lists, Tahfidz Surahs (Juz 30), Savings ledger history, and Teacher Journals.
Ensure all interactive elements have valid data-testid attributes.
